sources.finding: Edited keyframes can guide propagation; geometry must align; independently moving parts can use separate tracks; choose new keyframes where synthesized regions break.
Example-based synthesis uses keyframes, original video and region masks; temporal blending aims to retain texture coherence.
Video inpainting uses cross-frame propagation and spatiotemporal modeling; inaccurate flow may cause spatial misalignment.
